items.title: Try Sonnet for small and medium jobs
items.detail: Opus took 95% of Claude spend in the last 28 days. Your small and medium tasks cost a median $2.43 on Opus and $1.09 on Sonnet, and passed CI first time 84% and 100% of the time. Switch with /model sonnet for fixes and small features, and keep Opus for big or tricky work.

items.title: Start fresh after a break instead of resuming
items.detail: 18 cache rebuilds cost $9.95 in the last 7 days (19 the week before). Once a session sits idle for an hour its cache expires, and the next reply pays to write the whole conversation again. After a long break, start a new session with a short summary, or run /compact before you step away.

items.title: Ask for tests on the tricky part up front
items.detail: 42 later commits changed files from 10 tasks shipped in the last 28 days, most after PR #166 (8). Follow-up fixes usually mean the first pass missed a case, so ask Claude to write a test for the risky part before it builds.
